text: That is the engine. The actual engine. Lieutenant, with that we are a year ahead of everyone. With that, nobody needs to go to the Moon at all. Hand it through the hatch and your orders are complete. Every one of them.
I'm not going to insist. I've never had to.
Thank you, Lieutenant. Mr. Hale is in your debt. Your country is in your debt. The rocket will run on the stone; it's rougher, I'm told.
Lieutenant Ashworth. You're rather late. I had a man at the siding in Thalbach for you.
The crate, yes. Your crate. Please don't look at the sergeant like that; she had no part in it. I had no part in it. It was simply the orders.
That is why the program exists. It talks to the Moon, Lieutenant. Something on the Moon talks back. We would like to know what, before the Russians do.
Ashworth. For what it's worth. I hope it's a light and nothing more.
...I see. I shall note that you were under considerable strain.
